article: london (reuters)--a city council has approved a plan to replace 200 diesel buses with electric vehicles over the next three years. the first 50 buses will begin operating in september, officials said on tuesday. the project will cost 80 million pounds and will be funded by the council and a national transport grant. transport director sarah james said the new vehicles would reduce air pollution and lower maintenance costs. charging stations will be installed at two bus depots before the first vehicles arrive. existing routes and ticket prices will remain unchanged. the council said it would publish progress reports every six months.
